title: Op script by Chatgpt
script:
-- Create the Hub
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
local Frame = Instance.new("Frame")
local OpenCloseButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")

ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui
ScreenGui.Name = "CoramHub"

-- Hub Frame
Frame.Name = "MainFrame"
Frame.Parent = ScreenGui
Frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0) -- Red color
Frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 400)
Frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -150, 0.5, -200)
Frame.Draggable = true
Frame.Visible = true

-- Title
Title.Name = "Title"
Title.Parent = Frame
Title.Text = "Coram Hub"
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 50)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.7, 0, 0)
Title.TextScaled = true
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)

-- Open/Close Button
OpenCloseButton.Name = "OpenCloseButton"
OpenCloseButton.Parent = ScreenGui
OpenCloseButton.Text = "Open Hub"
OpenCloseButton.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 50)
OpenCloseButton.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 10)
OpenCloseButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
OpenCloseButton.TextScaled = true

-- Toggle Hub Visibility
OpenCloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    Frame.Visible = not Frame.Visible
    OpenCloseButton.Text = Frame.Visible and "Close Hub" or "Open Hub"
end)

-- Add Buttons for Features
local function createButton(name, text, position, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Text = text
    button.Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 40)
    button.Position = position
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0.7, 0, 0)
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    button.Parent = Frame
    button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
end

-- Features
createButton("HighlightPlayers", "Highlight Players", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.2, 0), function()
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
            highlight.Parent = player.Character
        end
    end
end)

createButton("JumpHigh", "Jump High", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.3, 0), function()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    if player.Character then
        player.Character.Humanoid.JumpPower = 150
    end
end)

createButton("ExplodePlayer", "Explode Player", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.4, 0), function()
    for _, player in pairs(game.Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player.Character then
            local explosion = Instance.new("Explosion")
            explosion.Position = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position
            explosion.Parent = workspace
        end
    end
end)

createButton("SpeedBoost", "Speed Boost", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.5, 0), function()
    local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
    if player.Character then
        player.Character.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 50
    end
end)

createButton("JumpScare", "Jumpscare", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.6, 0), function()
    local jumpscareGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui", game.CoreGui)
    local text = Instance.new("TextLabel", jumpscareGui)
    text.Text = "BOO!"
    text.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    text.TextScaled = true
    text.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    text.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    wait(5)
    jumpscareGui:Destroy()
end)

createButton("InsertWorld", "Insert World", UDim2.new(0.1, 0, 0.7, 0), function()
    local part = Instance.new("Part", workspace)
    part.Size = Vector3.new(50, 1, 50)
    part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
    part.Anchored = true
end)
